shared_elements: horizontal band of repeated triangular/chevron or zigzag signs
profile animal figures beneath the patterned band
schematic bird-like or long-necked animal in profile
elongated snake-like or curved linear animal forms
outline/incised relief style with sparse internal detailing
justification: The strongest correspondence is the distinctive combination of several arch-topped rectangular motifs set above a horizontal triangular/chevron band, with schematic profile animals occupying the zone below. The main difference is that B includes a more complex vertical arrangement with additional distinct creatures such as a scorpion and lower figures, while A is a shorter horizontal panel with fewer and less varied animal motifs.
